items.title: W.T. "Ed" Kirkeby Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: I think it was a clarinet, which was Ted Lewis, and a trumpet, of course, and I think the usual jazz band, trombone, and the drums.

ctx.x: Yeah, I think it was the original... I think it was a clarinet, which was Ted Lewis, and a trumpet, of course, and I think the usual jazz band, trombone, and the drums.
